Industries we plan around

Industries we plan around

What you sell, how you deliver it and where you operate all affect your setup. Find the starting questions for your industry.

These are starting points for discussion, not official licensing checklists. A specific operating model must be assessed before requirements or timelines can be confirmed. Where a card shows a photograph, it is a licensed image (see Image credits); photographs from outside Saudi Arabia are illustrative and are not our client sites.

Technology

Software, digital services and technology businesses

What to bring to the discussionProduct and service description; ownership records; proposed customer and delivery model; staffing plan.
